summary: AMTD IDEA Group filed a Form 6-K reporting that its subsidiary, The Generation Essentials Group (TGE), completed the acquisition of a 50% interest in The Ritz-Carlton, Perth for US$72 million (A$100 million), valuing the property at US$201 million (A$280 million). The transaction was announced via press release as successfully closed. No board recommendation or advisor was named. The acquisition expands TGE's hospitality portfolio to nearly 1,000 rooms. The close is already effective; watch for integration and performance of the property as a risk-arb angle, though post-completion, oversight shifts to operational execution.
